description:
## Mandatory context and boundaries
Read the parent epic first. Applicable owners: AGENTS.md; docs/agent-tools.md; docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md; docs/action-reuse.md; docs/testing-approach.md; docs/services/channels.md (communication/Jido bridge and provider contracts); docs/services/engine.md (history, admission, finalization and delivery). Read docs/documentation.md before documentation/skill edits, docs/services/system-config.md before credential fixtures, and local module @moduledoc before extending a helper. Apply code-quality for code and skill-creator for the skill.
Only test/ additions or backward-compatible support changes, lib/mix/tasks/zaq.test.gen.channel.ex, and .agents/skills/add-channel-integration-tests/** are authorized. Do not edit application modules, dependency source/pins, config, migrations, mix.exs, CI, or unrelated skills. Existing-test expectation changes require the testing handbook's explicit approval; this epic authorizes additive coverage, not changing expectations.
Use real bridges, NodeRouter, Engine admission/history/persistence and configured Agent execution. Only provider/LLM boundaries are faked. A production defect is a reported blocker with a reproducer; do not patch production, silently omit a scenario, weaken an assertion, or close the issue as complete.
Validation timing, failure handling and final gates are owned by docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Record executed commands/results in this issue. No new browser E2E is needed: this work adds test/developer infrastructure without changing a deployed UI journey. No commit/push/merge authorization is implied.

Parent epic: zaq-o9d

## Functional specification and files
Add test/support/channels/integration/drivers/mattermost.ex and test/zaq/channels/integration/providers/mattermost_test.exs; register Drivers.Mattermost in registry.ex. Extend test/support/mattermost_history_fixture.ex only when additive options avoid duplication; preserve all existing post/direct_post/http defaults and assertions.
Reuse MattermostHistoryFixture.post/4, direct_post/2 and its native WebSocket.Client.handle_in path. start/1 starts a loopback HTTP fake using the existing OpenAIStub server helper and returns connector URL/token, bot identity and fixture room/sender coordinates. connect/2 starts the actual bridge state as in the existing fixture; no real WebSocket network connection is required for this callback-boundary suite. Document that coverage starts at native WebSocket frame handling, not TCP/reconnect.
Emit full native posted frames, including channel_type D/O/P, post id, author/channel/time, mention list and root id. Preserve provider/source coordinates so same ids can be reused on different connector scopes.
HTTP fake handles real requests needed by these tests: profile reads, channel/member facts, exact root lookup, DM opening where used, typing/status/send/edit operations. Reuse known response builders; unexpected method/path/request shapes fail after observation. Record all attempts, distinguish create/edit, assign deterministic unique provider ids, and return faithful Mattermost receipts.
Script failures match exact operations/request content; default success for expected incidental status operations must not hide unexpected calls. Return facts consumed by real membership/routing checks rather than injecting blanket permission grants.
Capabilities must reflect actual Mattermost adapter semantics; native thread/root lookup scenarios are required here.

## Tests to add before implementation
- Driver contract and local HTTP request/response round trip.
- Direct and mentioned channel payloads normalize correctly through real ingress.
- Both bot-authored and human-authored roots with/without mention preserve existing admission policy.
- Exact room/root lookup cannot accept another room's root.
- Create/edit/typing classification, scripted send/edit errors, unexpected endpoint failure.
- Same source identifiers across two connector configs remain scoped; no external network use.
- Run existing mattermost_shared_history_integration_test.exs, jido_chat_delivery_test.exs and affected fixture consumers; do not change their expected behaviour.

## Branches/paths validated
DM, public/private room facts, mentioned/unmentioned messages, bot/human root, missing/root lookup error (fail closed), successful/failed provider requests, and metadata/source scope preservation.

## Mocking plan
Local Mattermost HTTP server only; native adapter callback and every ZAQ internal component remain real. Existing LLM stub is supplied by the common case. No alternative synthetic Incoming/Outgoing entry path.

## Documentation
Document driver transport boundary and supported endpoint/scenario set in module docs and the test README. Explain expected request matching and transcript lookup coordinates.

## Action reuse assessment
Reuse MattermostHistoryFixture and the real Jido.Chat.Mattermost.Adapter/WebSocket.Client. Extend helper options only if backward compatible. Driver/fake HTTP scripting are local-only test mechanics; persistence/auth/routing stay with existing contexts. Verify reuse by existing-consumer regressions plus the new contract.

## Done when
Mattermost is registered, complete callbacks pass the contract, a real prompt/reply is observable, provider-specific tests and existing regressions pass, and unsupported calls cannot silently succeed.

comments.text: Implemented Drivers.Mattermost with native MattermostHistoryFixture ingress, local REST profiles/membership/root/message/typing APIs, strict matched response scripts and provider-side message state. Registered Mattermost. Added direct/shared confirmed transcript checks, bot-root admission under explicit default policy, human-root passive capture, provider failure and unexpected-endpoint tests. Important current contract: mention_required gates all unmentioned room inputs, including bot-root replies; default-policy root eligibility is tested separately. Provider-created IDs use a distinct namespace to avoid collisions with inbound fixture IDs. Fixed the new observer to read RoutingContext structs via Map.get. Validation: canonical mix q passed; new integration suite plus existing mattermost_shared_history_integration_test.exs and jido_chat_delivery_test.exs passed together: 53 tests, 2 properties, 0 failures. Production/previous tests unchanged.

title: [zaq-o9d.3] Implement Mattermost provider driver using native frames and local HTTP
